name: pending-state-ledger-query-duplicated
body: `has_pending_state` inlines `pending_removals`' ledger query (`MATCH (n:PendingRemoval) RETURN n.fqn ORDER BY n.fqn`) to keep the read on one connection instead of opening a second handle, so the query string now lives in two places in this file. Upgrade to a connection-taking ledger reader shared by both callers when `pending_removals` gains a second caller that could reuse the same connection.
